module_outcomes: Ukuqonda mayelana noqweqwe lomhlaba, ilithosifeya, kanye nama- plate tectonic.

Ulwazi oluphelele mayelana nokwakhekha komhlaba ngenxa yeziwombe zezintaba-mlilo kanye nokunyakaza kwama-tectonic ngaphansi komhlaba, ukugqwala, ukuchitheka kwesisindo, umoya, amagagasi kanye nemisinga.
Ukuqonda izinhlelo zomkhathi okuhlanganisa umswakama kanye nemvula emkhathini, umoya kanye nokuzungeza komhlaba kanye nezinhlelo zesimo sezulu.
Ukwazi ukufunda kanye nokubhala imibiko ngokucwaningiwe maqondana nokunakekelwa kwendalo.

module_purpose: Inhloso yale mojuli ukunikezela ngamakhono kanye nolwazi lokuqonda izimo zokwenzeka emhlabeni kanye nezinqubo ezenzeka ngokwemvelo ukwakha izimo zomhlaba kanye nokuhlaziywa kwamazinga okushisa komoya, umswakama osemkhathini kanye nemvula, ukuzungeza komoya kanye nokomhlaba, kanye nezinhlelo zesimo sezulu. Lesi Sifundo sibuye sethule kubafundi izimo ezinkulu zezemvelo imiphakathi ebhekene nazo. Isayensi yezomhlaba yitemu eliqukethe konke kwezamasayensi aphathelene neplanethi ewumhlaba. Ngokujwayelekile, isayensi yezomhlaba ibheka imikhakha emine, ilithosifiye, ihayidrosifiye, umkhathi, kanye nendawokuphila, kanti ihambisana namadwala, amanzi, umoya kanye nempilo. Isayensi yezomkhathi ingomunye wemikhatha yeSayensi yoMhlaba. Ithinta zonke izingxenye ezinegesi/eziyigesi (noma umkhathi) phakathi kwengaphezulu komhlaba kuya kwi-exosphere (cishe ama-km ayi-1000). Imikhakha emikhulu etholakala lapha yi-meteorology, i-climatology, i- atmospheric chemistry ne-atmospheric physics. Le mojuli yethulela abafundi ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngesayensi yezomkhathi ngokuthinta izingxenye ezifana namazinga okushisa komoya, umswakama osemkhathini nemvula kanye nezinhlelo zesimo sezulu. Ukunakekelwa kwendalo kumayelana nezindlela imiphakathi ebhekana ngazo nezinkinga zendalo kanye nemizamo eyenziwa yizinhlangano, ohulumeni basekhaya, bezifundazwe kanye nohulumeni kazwelonke ukuvimbela, ukunqanda, ukulawula kanye nokunciphisa imithelela yalokho okwenziwa ngabantu endalweni. Ohulumeni kanye nezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe zibeka izinhlakakusebenza bese kuthi izinhlangano ngayinye zithole amasu ukuze zithobele imithetho elawulayo kanye nezinqubo zokuziphatha. 7 Ukunakekelwa kwendalo kungukusebenzisa izimiso zesayensi kanye nezokunakekela ohlelweni loshintsho. Kubandakanya ukuhlolwa kwezinkinga zezendalo futhi kuholela ekutholeni izinqubomgomo ezifanele kanye neziphakamiso ezisuselwa ekuqondeni okuyikho futhi okungaholela ekuthini kube nomnyakazo.
